description: Reconstructs the redirect chain of a URL hop by hop (HTTP 3xx and Refresh headers), re-validating every destination against SSRF rules, and reports meta-refresh/JavaScript redirects declared by the final page without executing them. Flags cross-domain redirects, open-redirect patterns, loops and HTTPS downgrades. Read-only: never submits forms or exploits endpoints.

request_context.description: Request headers preset. Non-browser contexts are simulations.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL whose redirect chain should be reconstructed.

name: geo_trace_redirects
title: Trace redirect chain
